title: Schedule of Cabin Inclusions and Seating Charges — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Every ticket sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands carries the cabin inclusions and the seating charges of the fare brand held on the booking. Charges are stated in US dollars for each traveller on each segment; hours are counted before the scheduled departure of the segment concerned.

| Fare brand | Standard seat chosen at no charge | Standard advance seat fee | Extra-legroom seat fee | Priority boarding | Priority boarding fee | Departure lounge access | Hot meal service | Onboard wifi voucher | Seat map released before departure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | not included | 22.00 dollars | 79.00 dollars | not included | 19.00 dollars | not included | not included | not included | 24 hours |
| Economy Saver | not included | 18.00 dollars | 69.00 dollars | not included | 15.00 dollars | not included | not included | not included | 24 hours |
| Economy Classic | included | 0.00 dollars | 59.00 dollars | not included | 15.00 dollars | not included | not included | not included | 48 hours |
| Economy Flex | included | 0.00 dollars | 49.00 dollars | included | 0.00 dollars | not included | included | not included | 48 hours |
| Premium Economy Select | included | 0.00 dollars | 0.00 dollars | included | 0.00 dollars | not included | included | included | 72 hours |
| Business Saver | included | 0.00 dollars | 0.00 dollars | included | 0.00 dollars | included | included | included | 96 hours |
| Business Flex | included | 0.00 dollars | 0.00 dollars | included | 0.00 dollars | included | included | included | 96 hours |

Annotations to the schedule:

1. Where a standard seat is included in the fare, the standard advance seat fee stands at 0.00 dollars and a seat may be chosen before check-in at no charge. Where it is not included, the fee shown falls due for each traveller on each segment on which a seat is chosen in advance: 22.00 dollars in Basic Economy Lite and 18.00 dollars in Economy Saver.

2. The extra-legroom charge stands on its own line and is shown for every brand, including the brands at 0.00 dollars. On a hypothetical booking of two segments in Economy Saver, one traveller taking an extra-legroom seat on each of them is charged 69.00 dollars for the first segment and 69.00 dollars for the second.

3. Priority boarding carries a fee only where it is not included in the fare, at 19.00 dollars in Basic Economy Lite and 15.00 dollars in Economy Saver and in Economy Classic; where it is included, the fee stands at 0.00 dollars.

4. The remaining seat map opens for free selection at the hours shown before departure. For a hypothetical Business Flex segment departing at 18:00 on a Friday, the map opens 96 hours earlier, at 18:00 on the preceding Monday. For a hypothetical Economy Saver segment departing at the same hour, it opens 24 hours earlier, at 18:00 on the Thursday of that week.
